subject: Re: Blackstone AI Guild - sponsorship flex credit & demo rotation negotiation
content:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha@blackstoneai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@blackstoneai.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Blackstone AI Guild — sponsor package: request to trade speaking slot for flex credits

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday — excited about the possibility of having Redwood as our Lead Sponsor at the AI Guild Summit (SF, Oct 14-15). We reviewed the sponsorship kit you shared and wanted to propose a small rework to the benefits mix that would better align with our customer activation plan.

Specifically: could we trade the 30-minute breakout speaking slot for 8 hours of demo pod time (to be used across both days) plus a $10k flex credit toward post-event email promotion? Our marketing team is prioritizing hands-on demos and targeted follow-ups; the speaking slot is useful but not as high-impact for our goals.

We attached a version of your sponsor package with our requested changes (see Blackstone_Sponsor_Package_v3.pdf). If that swap is feasible, wed expect a slightly updated SOW and a delivery timeline so we can start planning content.

Can you confirm feasibility and any impact to fee or logo placement (we care about one of the two hero banner positions for the summit website)?

Thanks,
Samantha Lowe
Head of Partnerships
Blackstone AI Guild


-----Original Message-----
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha@blackstoneai.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:05:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Blackstone AI Guild — sponsor package: request to trade speaking slot for flex credits

Hi Samantha — really appreciate the clarity on activation goals. Short answer: yes, we can do the swap, with some guardrails.

High-level proposal:
- Swap: 30-minute breakout -> 8 hours demo pod (split as 4 + 4 across both days).
- Add: $8,000 flex credit applied to post-event digital promotion (we can top up to $10k but would need a small fee adjustment).
- Logos: we can guarantee one hero position on the website and a top-tier booth logo on the on-site banner; hero placement is locked with the deposit.
- SOW: well send an updated SOW and a mock-up of hero placement within 48 business hours.

Impacts to pricing: the swap plus additional set-up and AV for extended demo hours increases the total package by $3,500. If Blackstone approves a $1,500 co-marketing credit (to cover part of the promotional flights), Redwood will absorb the remaining $2k so net increase becomes $2,000 to your side.

Ive looped in Lauren (partnerships ops) for the SOW and Tessa (events ops) for logistics — Lauren, Tessa: can you review and confirm AV / staffing assumptions for 8 demo hours and whether hero website placement is contractually bound at which point?

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference


On Fri, Aug 21, 2026 at 08:30:12 -0700 lauren.bishop@redwood.com wrote:
> From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
> To: Samantha Lowe <samantha@blackstoneai.com>; Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
> Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
> Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:30:12 -0700
> Subject: Re: Blackstone AI Guild — sponsor package: request to trade speaking slot for flex credits
>
> Hi Samantha,
>
> Thanks for the ask — quick ops notes from our side:
> - AV & staffing: 8 demo hours will require two demo leads (4-hour shifts) plus 1 floater engineer for troubleshooting; AV cabling and two dedicated power drops will be provided.
> - Footprint: well keep the demo pod within standard 10x10 footprint unless you want a double footprint (we can quote).
> - Website hero slot: hero logo is assignable on receipt of signed SOW + 50% deposit; placement is first-come-first-served across hero spots. We can hold the hero pending signature for 3 business days.
>
> Deliverables well include in updated SOW: deliverable schedule, staffing plan, AV spec, and exact logo dimensions/format. Ive attached a draft SOW for review (redwood-draft-sow-v2.docx).
>
> Samantha, if youd like to move forward at the $2k net increase (Redwood absorbing part of the set-up), let us know and well update the SOW and send a DocuSign.
>
> Best,
> Lauren Bishop
> Partnerships Ops Lead
> Redwood Inference


On Fri, Aug 21, 2026 at 14:12:44 -0700 Samantha Lowe <samantha@blackstoneai.com> wrote:
> Hi Dylan & Lauren,
>
> Appreciate the quick turnaround and the transparent proposal. Two quick clarifications from our side:
> 1) Can the demo hours be scheduled as 6 + 2 instead of 4 + 4? We have a keynote slot adjacent to the expo on day one and want a long contiguous block there.
> 2) Wed prefer the full $10k flex credit if possible — if Redwood cant cover the extra $2k, we can waive the co-marketing credit ask but would expect hero placement to be explicit in the SOW (no hold).
>
> If we can confirm scheduling and the $10k credit, well sign quickly. Im copying Evan (ops) for scheduling specifics.
>
> Thanks,
> Samantha
>
> --
> Samantha Lowe
> Head of Partnerships
> Blackstone AI Guild
>
>
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha@blackstoneai.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Blackstone AI Guild — sponsor package: request to trade speaking slot for flex credits

Samantha —

Thanks for the clarifications. We can do 6 + 2 scheduling (place the 6-hour contiguous block adjacent to your keynote on day one). And were able to confirm the full $10k flex credit if Blackstone signs the SOW at the updated net price (no additional co-marketing credit required).

Next steps:
1) I will email the updated SOW and the hero placement mock to the email thread within the hour.
2) Well hold the hero position for 48 hours from SOW delivery pending your 50% deposit.
3) DocuSign link will be attached to the SOW for signature.

Attachment note: current attachments in this thread: Blackstone_Sponsor_Package_v3.pdf (Blackstone suggested edits), redwood-draft-sow-v2.docx (Redwood draft SOW).

Looking forward to finalizing — excited to have Blackstone in the room.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
